name: TicketBusinessIdentifiers

service_request.parse_official: accept exactly eight ASCII decimal digits after presentation-only prefix/label removal performed by the explicitly owning source/UI adapter; canonical stored value is the eight digits only
service_request.local: allocate through sr_local_id_allocator and format LSR-%08d
prohibitions: never truncate/extract digits from malformed official input
never use presentation 'SR' or 'TT' label as canonical stored identity

rfc.canonical: exactly 'NC' followed by fourteen ASCII decimal digits
rfc.validate: whole value must match canonical form; canonical substring inside a longer/malformed value never resolves identity
rfc.branch_artifact_classification: source adapters may classify a value as recognized branch artifact only under their accepted source-family rule; branch artifact is skipped/non-mutating and is never normalized into the base RFC by this parser
rfc.malformed: anything neither canonical nor explicitly recognized source branch artifact is invalid
prohibitions: no suffix stripping in domain parser

device_reference.rule: operational_name/hostname equality can only support a downstream regularization candidate; it never proves Device Reference or Network Element identity

result_contract: parsers return typed VALID/INVALID/RECOGNIZED_SOURCE_ARTIFACT outcomes with canonical value only when VALID; they never perform persistence mutation.
